category_title: Reluctant communicators who avoid using communication aids and struggle to make choices
student_description: Lily is a student with limited verbal output who actively resists using traditional communication aids (like books or signing) and struggles with open-ended questions. She uniquely needs highly structured binary choices and thrives when allowed to participate through physical acting, miming, and sensory engagement (such as using costumes) rather than verbal or signed communication.

criteria.rationale: Providing shared, anchored experiences and using photos as visual prompts gives Lily a concrete foundation to support her communication over a multi-week project.
criteria.check: The long-term plan incorporates shared physical experiences (e.g., real-world visits) and uses photos or visual media from those experiences as ongoing prompts for story-making.
